newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George sets US$150 mln note issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George sets US$150 mln note issue.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said on Monday it has issued US$150 million of subordinated notes with a 10-year maturity and a coupon of 7.15 percent.
The notes were sold to U.S. institutional investors
The Reserve Bank of Australia has classified the notes as Tier Two capital for the bank, St George said.
Merrill Lynch and Credit Suisse First Boston were joint lead managers for the transaction, it said.
St George has raised about US$400 million in debt securities as part of its funding for the acquisition earlier this year of the Advance Bank of Australia.
